# Fields of PoolPlan, StepShape and Transfer that a test shows change a price (design SUB-11).
# One line each: Type.Field # the test that moves a price when the field changes, as
# package: TestName. TestEveryPlanFieldIsPricedOrListed checks that the named test exists in the
# repository, and that a field is on this list or on unpriced_plan_fields.txt, never both. A field
# moves here from the unpriced list in the change that prices it.
StepShape.DecodeQueryLen # kernel: TestTheDecodeThresholdTheEngineStatesMovesTheStepPrice
DraftPass.Padded # kernel: TestADrafterPaddedByItsGroupIsPricedAsPadded
DraftShape.Passes # kernel: TestADrafterPassIsReadFromTheRankItBelongsTo
